[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1rs[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]sase-spotify: Spotify library reads and gated playlist changes for [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]SASE agents[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]SASE agents of any provider can read Bryan's Spotify library [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]through `sase spotify` and a `/sase_spotify` skill: every playlist,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the songs in owned and collaborative playlists and Liked Songs, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]followed podcasts, and their recent episodes. Library data never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reaches a publicly published agent chat, because the CLI enforces [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that boundary itself. Agents change playlists only by proposing one[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]declarative changeset per task. Bryan reviews it as a PR-style SASE[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gate in the TUI or on Telegram, and only the option he approves [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]writes to Spotify; that write is re-checked, journaled, reconciled,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and verified. The new private sase-org/sase-spotify plugin ships [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with excellent docs, a strict test suite, and CI. It is installed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and accepted end to end on athena.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Private repository and SASE project, created through a gate[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]implement the shared foundation modules: paths, config, errors, the JSON[/#D7D7AF]
